title: Non-success response — all management v1.0 errors
$comment: RC2 §13. Unlike the success responses, the error envelope carries no observed_at: §8's observed_at rule is stated for SUCCESSFUL responses, and §13's envelope names only contract_version and error. Per §2, member names are normative. See README 'Interpretations taken', item I-4.

message.$comment: RC2 §13: fixed, generic strings. MUST NOT contain exception text or internal identifiers — a content property no schema can verify; see invariant note in README.

correlation_id.$comment: RC2 §13: provider-generated UUID v4, always present, returned in both the body and the X-Correlation-ID header. Never presented as the caller's request ID.

request_id.$comment: RC2 §13: present with the caller's exact value only when the inbound X-Request-ID was a valid UUID v4; otherwise ABSENT (never null, and never a fabricated substitute).

retryable.$comment: RC2 §13 error table. Constrained per-code by the allOf below.

allOf.$comment: RC2 §13: 429, 500 and 503 are the retryable conditions.
RC2 §13: every other code is non-retryable. §5 forbids the consumer retrying them regardless of intermediary behaviour.
